title: Uploading incorrect delta to Nightscout
symptom: The delta reported by the Nightscout API (e.g., /api/v1/entries/current.json) is different from the actual BG delta, while the delta shown in xDrip and Nightscout (non-API) is correct. This occurs with Dexcom G6 but not with Dexcom G5.
evidence_quote: The delta reported by the nightscout API (for example `/api/v1/entries/current.json`) is different from the actual BG delta. According to @sulkaharo this is caused by xDrip uploading incorrect deltas to Nightscout.
